text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A live TV appearance... and they even 
prepared a cake to congratulate me on my 
hard work... This is so 
un-princess-like... totally unbecoming of 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I acted so selfishly, convincing 
myself that I was the only heroine. I 
ended up hurting so many people...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To someone like me... you say you want us 
to grow together, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I'm so sorry! I promise to act in a 
way befitting a princess from now on~!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the "Kinko Sho." Until everyone 
acknowledges me, I shall seal away my 
princess-like special moves...
